The day symbols, Chuen, Caban, and others, when they have an affix denoting the beginning of a katun or cycle, are declarative of that event.

The signs for the months are also frequently qualified by affixes which render them declarative of the position of the day in the month.

The declarative signs are, therefore, very numerous, and their proper interpretation is of the utmost importance in the study of the inscriptions.
